title: Kelly Johnson's UFO sighting
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kelly Johnson's UFO sighting, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: at approximately 5:00 p.m. uh Mr Johnson was looking out of a large window facing the west and just watching the sunset he watched this black thing
Kelly Johnson, who is um the uh skunk works, the basically the the most famous, the most well-known aeronautical engineer in American history, sees the same object from his ranch.
tellings.difference: Places it at his ranch in Southern California near the Channel Islands, says a Lockheed crew saw it too, and calls the object elliptical.
tellings.link_reason: Both tellings are Kelly Johnson's own sighting, where he watched a dark object from his window at sunset.
